# Meridian Operations Hub

Meridian Operations Hub is an offline-first operations system for a mid-sized US direct-to-consumer retailer. This build runs fully on a local network and includes hiring, customer support, inventory, and compliance workflows.

## Stack

- Backend: Go + Gin + PostgreSQL
- Frontend: Go + Templ (H5 mobile-first, responsive)
- Orchestration: Docker Compose

## Repository Layout

```text
.
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ README.md
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ .env.example
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ docker-compose.yml
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ backend/
ΓööΓöÇΓöÇ frontend/
```

## Features in this MVP

- RBAC with module/action permissions and scope checks
- Data masking for SSN fields
- Encryption-at-rest for sensitive fields (`candidates.ssn_raw`) with key-version envelopes
- Request signing, nonce replay defense, idempotency records
- JWT access/refresh auth, lockout rules, and step-up verification
- Hiring pipeline templates/transitions, blocklist, candidate dedup scoring
- Support tickets with return eligibility, SLA due-time, attachment checks
- Inventory reservations with deterministic warehouse allocation and auto-release
- Immutable inventory ledger with reversal entries
- Compliance crawler, retention/deletion controls, and audit trail APIs

## Frontend Routes

- `/dashboard`: cross-module overview with role-aware quick actions
- `/hiring`: job posting, manual/kiosk intake, CSV import, transition actions, application list
- `/support`: ticket lifecycle, attachment UX, offline draft, optimistic update/conflict handling
- `/inventory`: inbound/outbound/transfer/cycle count forms, balances, reservation list/actions
- `/compliance`: crawler controls, retention, deletion requests, audit log viewer/export

## Role-Based UI Behavior

- Frontend fetches `/api/auth/me` after session establishment.
- Navigation tabs, module cards, and action buttons are hidden/disabled when permissions are missing.
- Backend remains authoritative for permission/scope enforcement.

## Gap-Closure Hardening (latest)

- Enforced signed requests on all `/api/*` routes (including GET/HEAD).
- Added nonce replay rejection coverage for read and write API paths.
- Added encrypted-at-rest handling for sensitive candidate SSN with key version support.
- Added duplicate blocklist rule evaluation into severity resolution (`info/warn/block`).
- Updated SLA calendar engine to honor configured `weekend_days` and `holidays`.
- Fixed support conflict resolution URL usage to always use ticket ID.
- Added role-aware frontend action/module visibility using `/api/auth/me` permissions.
- Added compliance audit log export endpoint (CSV/JSON), permission-gated by `export` and step-up token.
- Added backend and frontend tests for critical security/business rules.

## Prerequisites

- Docker + Docker Compose
- 4+ GB RAM for local containers

## Local Setup

1. Copy and edit environment values:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

2. Build and start all services:

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

3. Open frontend and backend health:

- Frontend: `http://localhost:8081`
- Backend health: `http://localhost:8080/healthz`

## Default Users and Roles

All default users use password `LocalAdminPass123!`:

- `admin` -> System Administrator
- `recruiter1` -> HR Recruiter
- `manager1` -> Hiring Manager
- `clerk1` -> Warehouse Clerk
- `agent1` -> Customer Service Agent
- `compliance1` -> Compliance Officer

Signing bootstrap key:

- Key ID: `local-h5`
- Secret: `local-h5-secret-change-me`

## Security Notes

- Password minimum length: 12 characters
- Lockout: 5 failed logins -> 15 minutes
- Step-up token required for sensitive actions (5-minute validity)
- Signed headers required for all `/api/*` routes:
  - `X-Client-Key`
  - `X-Timestamp` (RFC3339)
  - `X-Nonce`
  - `X-Signature`
- Idempotency key required for reservation order creation and refund approval routes
- Sensitive export actions require step-up and `export` permission.

## New Environment Variables

- `PII_KEY_NAME`: encryption key namespace used for sensitive field encryption.
- `PII_KEY_VALUE`: initial local key material for bootstrap/key version 1.

## Running Tests and Checks

Build/health checks:

```bash
docker compose build
docker compose up -d
curl http://localhost:8080/healthz
```

Backend tests (containerized Go):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
```

Frontend tests (containerized Go + templ generate):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine sh -lc "/usr/local/go/bin/go run -mod=mod github.com/a-h/templ/cmd/templ@v0.2.793 generate && /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./..."
```

Sample login (via frontend RPC proxy):

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8081/rpc/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"LocalAdminPass123!"}'
```

## Important Operational Notes

- Inventory ledger rows are immutable by DB trigger; reversals are linked records.
- Reservation holds release automatically after expiry via worker.
- Retention/anonymization jobs run in worker loop.
- Crawler indexes only approved sources and honors opt-out markers.

- `manager1` -> Hiring Manager
- `clerk1` -> Warehouse Clerk
- `agent1` -> Customer Service Agent
- `compliance1` -> Compliance Officer

Signing bootstrap key:

- Key ID: `local-h5`
- Secret: `local-h5-secret-change-me`

## Security Notes

- Password minimum length: 12 characters
- Lockout: 5 failed logins -> 15 minutes
- Step-up token required for sensitive actions (5-minute validity)
- Signed headers required for all `/api/*` routes:
  - `X-Client-Key`
  - `X-Timestamp` (RFC3339)
  - `X-Nonce`
  - `X-Signature`
- Idempotency key required for reservation order creation and refund approval routes
- Sensitive export actions require step-up and `export` permission.

## New Environment Variables

- `PII_KEY_NAME`: encryption key namespace used for sensitive field encryption.
- `PII_KEY_VALUE`: initial local key material for bootstrap/key version 1.

## Running Tests and Checks

Build/health checks:

```bash
docker compose build
docker compose up -d
curl http://localhost:8080/healthz
```

Backend tests (containerized Go):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
```

Frontend tests (containerized Go + templ generate):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
```

Sample login (via frontend RPC proxy):

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8081/rpc/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"LocalAdminPass123!"}'
```

## Important Operational Notes

- Inventory ledger rows are immutable by DB trigger; reversals are linked records.
- Reservation holds release automatically after expiry via worker.
- Retention/anonymization jobs run in worker loop.
- Crawler indexes only approved sources and honors opt-out markers.

You are a senior full-stack engineer. Complete the missing frontend and related integration features in this repository to satisfy the product prompt requirements. Work only within this project root.

## Objective
Close remaining feature gaps so the UI is production-ready for role-based operations across Hiring, Support, Inventory, and Compliance workflows.

## Missing Features To Implement

1) Role-based frontend module visibility and action gating
- After login, fetch current user identity + effective permissions/scopes.
- Render only modules allowed for that role.
- Hide/disable unauthorized actions in the UI.
- Keep backend authz as source of truth; frontend gating is UX + defense-in-depth.

2) Real module pages (not only dashboard demo actions)
- Build dedicated pages/views for:
  - Hiring
  - Support
  - Inventory
  - Compliance
- Keep mobile-first H5 design and responsive behavior.
- Preserve unified visual system (shared components/theme tokens).

3) Hiring workflow UI completion
- Job posting form and list.
- Candidate intake:
  - Manual entry
  - Kiosk-style entry flow
  - CSV import with row-level validation/error feedback
- Pipeline board/list with stage transitions.
- Required-field validation on transition.
- Show blocklist and duplicate-match outcomes with clear status messaging.
- Candidate event timeline view.

4) Support workflow UI completion
- Ticket creation linked to order, type selection (return+refund/refund-only), priority, description.
- Attachment upload UX (max 5, JPG/PNG/PDF, max 10MB each) with clear errors.
- SLA timer and escalation indicator on ticket details.
- Offline draft persistence and restore.
- Optimistic updates with rollback messaging.
- Retry queue UX under weak/offline network.
- Conflict prompt flow (merge/overwrite/discard) wired correctly to ticket ID conflict endpoint.

5) Inventory workflow UI completion
- Views/forms for inbound, outbound, transfer, cycle count.
- Reservation creation/confirm/release flow with clear status transitions.
- Low-stock warnings using returned threshold signals.
- Show multi-warehouse/sub-warehouse context in list/detail views.
- Confirmation dialogs for stock-affecting operations.

6) Compliance workflow UI completion
- Crawler run/status UI.
- Retention status UI.
- Deletion request create/process UI (role-guarded).
- Audit log viewer with pagination/filter basics.
- Export UI for authorized roles (if backend endpoint exists; otherwise add both backend + UI).

7) Frontend signing/auth session consistency
- Ensure all `/api/*` calls from frontend include required signed headers and nonce handling.
- Keep access/refresh token lifecycle reliable.
- Preserve step-up flow for sensitive actions with proper prompts and expiry handling.

8) UX/system hardening
- Consistent loading/empty/error states across all pages.
- Standardized toast/banner notifications.
- Accessibility baseline: labels, focus states, keyboard access for key actions.
- Keep styles consistent with existing theme tokens and component patterns.

## Backend/Integration Adjustments Allowed (within this repo)
Implement only what is necessary to support frontend completion and strict prompt alignment:
- Add missing read/list endpoints needed by new pages.
- Add export endpoint(s) gated by `export` permission if absent.
- Keep existing security middleware and RBAC model intact.
- Do not remove immutable ledger constraints or audit behavior.

## Quality Requirements
- Add tests for critical flows added or changed:
  - Frontend behavior tests for permission-driven visibility and conflict URL routing.
  - Backend tests for any new endpoint/security-sensitive behavior.
- No breaking changes to existing working auth/login/reservation/ticket flows.
- Keep code modular and maintainable.

## Deliverables
1. Updated code for frontend pages/components/state/services.
2. Any required backend endpoint additions.
3. Tests for new/changed critical behavior.
4. Updated README with:
   - new UI routes/pages
   - role behavior summary
   - run/test instructions
5. Brief implementation report mapping each missing feature to files changed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Non-admin users only see modules/actions they are permitted to use.
- Hiring/Support/Inventory/Compliance pages are functional end-to-end from UI.
- Offline draft/retry/conflict flows work in support module.
- Low-stock and reservation workflows are fully visible and actionable in inventory UI.
- Compliance operations are usable from UI with proper authorization.
- Security/session/signing behavior remains valid across all API interactions.
- Tests pass and documentation reflects the new behavior.

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"meridian/backend/internal/bootstrap"
	"meridian/backend/internal/config"
	"meridian/backend/internal/http/handlers"
	"meridian/backend/internal/http/middleware"
	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/db"
	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/security"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.Load()

	database, err := db.Open(cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("db open failed: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	migrationDir := filepath.Join(".", "migrations")
	if _, err := os.Stat(migrationDir); err != nil {
		migrationDir = filepath.Join("/app", "migrations")
	}
	if err := db.Migrate(context.Background(), database, migrationDir); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("migration failed: %v", err)
	}

<content>1: # Meridian Operations Hub
2: 
3: Meridian Operations Hub is an offline-first operations system for a mid-sized US direct-to-consumer retailer. This build runs fully on a local network and includes hiring, customer support, inventory, and compliance workflows.
4: 
5: ## Stack
6: 
7: - Backend: Go + Gin + PostgreSQL
8: - Frontend: Go + Templ (H5 mobile-first, responsive)
9: - Orchestration: Docker Compose
10: 
11: ## Repository Layout
12: 
13: ```text
14: .
15: Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ README.md
16: Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ .env.example
17: Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ docker-compose.yml
18: Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ backend/
19: ΓööΓöÇΓöÇ frontend/
20: ```
21: 
22: ## Features in this MVP
23: 
24: - RBAC with module/action permissions and scope checks
25: - Data masking for SSN fields
26: - Encryption-at-rest for sensitive fields (`candidates.ssn_raw`) with key-version envelopes
27: - Request signing, nonce replay defense, idempotency records
28: - JWT access/refresh auth, lockout rules, and step-up verification
29: - Hiring pipeline templates/transitions, blocklist, candidate dedup scoring
30: - Support tickets with return eligibility, SLA due-time, attachment checks
31: - Inventory reservations with deterministic warehouse allocation and auto-release
32: - Immutable inventory ledger with reversal entries
33: - Compliance crawler, retention/deletion controls, and audit trail APIs
34: 
35: ## Frontend Routes
36: 
37: - `/dashboard`: cross-module overview with role-aware quick actions
38: - `/hiring`: job posting, manual/kiosk intake, CSV import, transition actions, application list
39: - `/support`: ticket lifecycle, attachment UX, offline draft, optimistic update/conflict handling
40: - `/inventory`: inbound/outbound/transfer/cycle count forms, balances, reservation list/actions
41: - `/compliance`: crawler controls, retention, deletion requests, audit log viewer/export
42: 
43: ## Role-Based UI Behavior
44: 
45: - Frontend fetches `/api/auth/me` after session establishment.
46: - Navigation tabs, module cards, and action buttons are hidden/disabled when permissions are missing.
47: - Backend remains authoritative for permission/scope enforcement.
48: 
49: ## Gap-Closure Hardening (latest)
50: 
51: - Enforced signed requests on all `/api/*` routes (including GET/HEAD).
52: - Added nonce replay rejection coverage for read and write API paths.
53: - Added encrypted-at-rest handling for sensitive candidate SSN with key version support.
54: - Added duplicate blocklist rule evaluation into severity resolution (`info/warn/block`).
55: - Updated SLA calendar engine to honor configured `weekend_days` and `holidays`.
56: - Fixed support conflict resolution URL usage to always use ticket ID.
57: - Added role-aware frontend action/module visibility using `/api/auth/me` permissions.
58: - Added compliance audit log export endpoint (CSV/JSON), permission-gated by `export` and step-up token.
59: - Added backend and frontend tests for critical security/business rules.
60: 
61: ## Prerequisites
62: 
63: - Docker + Docker Compose
64: - 4+ GB RAM for local containers
65: 
66: ## Local Setup
67: 
68: 1. Copy and edit environment values:
69: 
70: ```bash
71: cp .env.example .env
72: ```
73: 
74: 2. Build and start all services:
75: 
76: ```bash
77: docker compose up --build
78: ```
79: 
80: 3. Open frontend and backend health:
81: 
82: - Frontend: `http://localhost:8081`
83: - Backend health: `http://localhost:8080/healthz`
84: 
85: ## Default Users and Roles
86: 
87: All default users use password `LocalAdminPass123!`:
88: 
89: - `admin` -> System Administrator
90: - `recruiter1` -> HR Recruiter
91: - `manager1` -> Hiring Manager
92: - `clerk1` -> Warehouse Clerk
93: - `agent1` -> Customer Service Agent
94: - `compliance1` -> Compliance Officer
95: 
96: Signing bootstrap key:
97: 
98: - Key ID: `local-h5`
99: - Secret: `local-h5-secret-change-me`
100: 
101: ## Security Notes
102: 
103: - Password minimum length: 12 characters
104: - Lockout: 5 failed logins -> 15 minutes
105: - Step-up token required for sensitive actions (5-minute validity)
106: - Signed headers required for all `/api/*` routes:
107:   - `X-Client-Key`
108:   - `X-Timestamp` (RFC3339)
109:   - `X-Nonce`
110:   - `X-Signature`
111: - Idempotency key required for reservation order creation and refund approval routes
112: - Sensitive export actions require step-up and `export` permission.
113: 
114: ## New Environment Variables
115: 
116: - `PII_KEY_NAME`: encryption key namespace used for sensitive field encryption.
117: - `PII_KEY_VALUE`: initial local key material for bootstrap/key version 1.
118: 
119: ## Running Tests and Checks
120: 
121: Build/health checks:
122: 
123: ```bash
124: docker compose build
125: docker compose up -d
126: curl http://localhost:8080/healthz
127: ```
128: 
129: Backend tests (containerized Go):
130: 
131: ```bash
132: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
133: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
134: ```
135: 
136: Frontend tests (containerized Go + templ generate):
137: 
138: ```bash
139: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
140: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
141: ```
142: 
143: Sample login (via frontend RPC proxy):
144: 
145: ```bash
146: curl -X POST http://localhost:8081/rpc/login \
147:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
148:   -d '{"username":"admin","password":"LocalAdminPass123!"}'
149: ```
150: 
151: ## Important Operational Notes
152: 
153: - Inventory ledger rows are immutable by DB trigger; reversals are linked records.
154: - Reservation holds release automatically after expiry via worker.
155: - Retention/anonymization jobs run in worker loop.
156: - Crawler indexes only approved sources and honors opt-out markers.

# Meridian Operations Hub

Meridian Operations Hub is an offline-first operations system for a mid-sized US direct-to-consumer retailer. This build runs fully on a local network and includes hiring, customer support, inventory, and compliance workflows.

## Stack

- Backend: Go + Gin + PostgreSQL
- Frontend: Go + Templ (H5 mobile-first, responsive)
- Orchestration: Docker Compose

## Repository Layout

```text
.
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ README.md
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ .env.example
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ docker-compose.yml
Γö£ΓöÇΓöÇ backend/
ΓööΓöÇΓöÇ frontend/
```

## Features in this MVP

- RBAC with module/action permissions and scope checks
- Data masking for SSN fields
- Encryption-at-rest for sensitive fields (`candidates.ssn_raw`) with key-version envelopes
- Request signing, nonce replay defense, idempotency records
- JWT access/refresh auth, lockout rules, and step-up verification
- Hiring pipeline templates/transitions, blocklist, candidate dedup scoring
- Support tickets with return eligibility, SLA due-time, attachment checks
- Inventory reservations with deterministic warehouse allocation and auto-release
- Immutable inventory ledger with reversal entries
- Compliance crawler, retention/deletion controls, and audit trail APIs

## Frontend Routes

- `/dashboard`: cross-module overview with role-aware quick actions
- `/hiring`: job posting, manual/kiosk intake, CSV import, transition actions, application list
- `/support`: ticket lifecycle, attachment UX, offline draft, optimistic update/conflict handling
- `/inventory`: inbound/outbound/transfer/cycle count forms, balances, reservation list/actions
- `/compliance`: crawler controls, retention, deletion requests, audit log viewer/export

## Role-Based UI Behavior

- Frontend fetches `/api/auth/me` after session establishment.
- Navigation tabs, module cards, and action buttons are hidden/disabled when permissions are missing.
- Backend remains authoritative for permission/scope enforcement.

## Gap-Closure Hardening (latest)

- Enforced signed requests on all `/api/*` routes (including GET/HEAD).
- Added nonce replay rejection coverage for read and write API paths.
- Added encrypted-at-rest handling for sensitive candidate SSN with key version support.
- Added duplicate blocklist rule evaluation into severity resolution (`info/warn/block`).
- Updated SLA calendar engine to honor configured `weekend_days` and `holidays`.
- Fixed support conflict resolution URL usage to always use ticket ID.
- Added role-aware frontend action/module visibility using `/api/auth/me` permissions.
- Added compliance audit log export endpoint (CSV/JSON), permission-gated by `export` and step-up token.
- Added backend and frontend tests for critical security/business rules.

## Prerequisites

- Docker + Docker Compose
- 4+ GB RAM for local containers

## Local Setup

1. Copy and edit environment values:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

2. Build and start all services:

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

3. Open frontend and backend health:

- Frontend: `http://localhost:8081`
- Backend health: `http://localhost:8080/healthz`

## Default Users and Roles

All default users use password `LocalAdminPass123!`:

- `admin` -> System Administrator
- `recruiter1` -> HR Recruiter
- `manager1` -> Hiring Manager
- `clerk1` -> Warehouse Clerk
- `agent1` -> Customer Service Agent
- `compliance1` -> Compliance Officer

Signing bootstrap key:

- Key ID: `local-h5`
- Secret: `local-h5-secret-change-me`

## Security Notes

- Password minimum length: 12 characters
- Lockout: 5 failed logins -> 15 minutes
- Step-up token required for sensitive actions (5-minute validity)
- Signed headers required for all `/api/*` routes:
  - `X-Client-Key`
  - `X-Timestamp` (RFC3339)
  - `X-Nonce`
  - `X-Signature`
- Idempotency key required for reservation order creation and refund approval routes
- Sensitive export actions require step-up and `export` permission.

## New Environment Variables

- `PII_KEY_NAME`: encryption key namespace used for sensitive field encryption.
- `PII_KEY_VALUE`: initial local key material for bootstrap/key version 1.

## Running Tests and Checks

Build/health checks:

```bash
docker compose build
docker compose up -d
curl http://localhost:8080/healthz
```

Backend tests (containerized Go):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
```

Frontend tests (containerized Go + templ generate):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
```

Sample login (via frontend RPC proxy):

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8081/rpc/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"LocalAdminPass123!"}'
```

## Important Operational Notes

- Inventory ledger rows are immutable by DB trigger; reversals are linked records.
- Reservation holds release automatically after expiry via worker.
- Retention/anonymization jobs run in worker loop.
- Crawler indexes only approved sources and honors opt-out markers.

- JWT access/refresh auth, lockout rules, and step-up verification
- Hiring pipeline templates/transitions, blocklist, candidate dedup scoring
- Support tickets with return eligibility, SLA due-time, attachment checks
- Inventory reservations with deterministic warehouse allocation and auto-release
- Immutable inventory ledger with reversal entries
- Compliance crawler, retention/deletion controls, and audit trail APIs

## Frontend Routes

- `/`: login shell and session bootstrap
- `/dashboard`: cross-module overview with role-aware quick actions
- `/hiring`: job posting, manual/kiosk intake, CSV import, pipeline template manager, transition actions, application list/timeline
- `/hiring/kiosk`: dedicated candidate self-intake page for kiosk/tablet mode
- `/hiring/kiosk/qr`: QR image endpoint for kiosk deep-link sharing (`?url=` optional)
- `/support`: ticket lifecycle, attachment UX, offline draft, optimistic update/conflict handling
- `/inventory`: inbound/outbound/transfer/cycle count forms, balances, reservation list/actions
- `/compliance`: crawler controls, retention, deletion requests, audit log viewer/export

## Key Hiring APIs

- `GET /api/hiring/pipelines/templates`: list active/inactive pipeline templates
- `GET /api/hiring/pipelines/templates/:id`: fetch one pipeline template definition
- `PUT /api/hiring/pipelines/templates/:id`: update a pipeline template and validation settings
- `GET /api/hiring/applications/:id/allowed-transitions`: derive allowed next states for an application

## Role-Based UI Behavior

- Frontend fetches `/api/auth/me` after session establishment.
- Navigation tabs, module cards, and action buttons are hidden/disabled when permissions are missing.
- Backend remains authoritative for permission/scope enforcement.

## Gap-Closure Hardening (latest)

- Enforced signed requests on all `/api/*` routes (including GET/HEAD).
- Added nonce replay rejection coverage for read and write API paths.
- Added encrypted-at-rest handling for sensitive candidate SSN with key version support.
- Added duplicate blocklist rule evaluation into severity resolution (`info/warn/block`).
- Updated SLA calendar engine to honor configured `weekend_days` and `holidays`.
- Fixed support conflict resolution URL usage to always use ticket ID.
- Added role-aware frontend action/module visibility using `/api/auth/me` permissions.
- Added compliance audit log export endpoint (CSV/JSON), permission-gated by `export` and step-up token.
- Added backend and frontend tests for critical security/business rules.

## Prerequisites

- Docker + Docker Compose
- 4+ GB RAM for local containers

## Local Setup

1. Copy and edit environment values:

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

2. Build and start all services:

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

3. Open frontend and backend health:

- Frontend: `http://localhost:8081`
- Backend health: `http://localhost:8080/healthz`

## Default Users and Roles

All default users use password `LocalAdminPass123!`:

- `admin` -> System Administrator
- `recruiter1` -> HR Recruiter
- `manager1` -> Hiring Manager
- `clerk1` -> Warehouse Clerk
- `agent1` -> Customer Service Agent
- `compliance1` -> Compliance Officer

Signing bootstrap key:

- Key ID: `local-h5`
- Secret: `local-h5-secret-change-me`

## Security Notes

- Password minimum length: 12 characters
- Lockout: 5 failed logins -> 15 minutes
- Step-up token required for sensitive actions (5-minute validity)
- Signed headers required for all `/api/*` routes:
  - `X-Client-Key`
  - `X-Timestamp` (RFC3339)
  - `X-Nonce`
  - `X-Signature`
- Idempotency key required for reservation order creation and refund approval routes
- Sensitive export actions require step-up and `export` permission.

## New Environment Variables

- `PII_KEY_NAME`: encryption key namespace used for sensitive field encryption.
- `PII_KEY_VALUE`: initial local key material for bootstrap/key version 1.

## Running Tests and Checks

Build/health checks:

```bash
docker compose build
docker compose up -d
curl http://localhost:8080/healthz
```

Backend tests (containerized Go):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
```

Frontend tests (containerized Go):

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go mod tidy
docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W)/frontend:/src" -w /src golang:1.23-alpine /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...
```

Sample login (via frontend RPC proxy):

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8081/rpc/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"LocalAdminPass123!"}'
```

## Important Operational Notes

- Inventory ledger rows are immutable by DB trigger; reversals are linked records.
- Reservation holds release automatically after expiry via worker.
- Retention/anonymization jobs run in worker loop.
- Crawler indexes only approved sources and honors opt-out markers.

<path>C:\Users\dagim\Projects\Eagle Point AI\Task-41\fullstack\backend\internal\http\handlers\hiring.go</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>1: package handlers
2: 
3: import (
4: 	"database/sql"
5: 	"fmt"
6: 	"net/http"
7: 	"strings"
8: 	"time"
9: 
10: 	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
11: 	"github.com/google/uuid"
12: 	"meridian/backend/internal/domain/hiring"
13: 	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/masking"
14: 	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/security"
15: 	"meridian/backend/internal/service"
16: )
17: 
18: type HiringHandler struct {
19: 	DB  *sql.DB
20: 	Svc *service.HiringService
21: 	PII *security.PIIProtector
22: }
23: 
24: func NewHiringHandler(db *sql.DB, enableFuzzy bool, pii *security.PIIProtector) *HiringHandler {
25: 	return &HiringHandler{DB: db, Svc: service.NewHiringService(db, enableFuzzy), PII: pii}
26: }
27: 
28: func (h *HiringHandler) CreateJob(c *gin.Context) {
29: 	var req struct {
30: 		Code        string `json:"code"`
31: 		Title       string `json:"title"`
32: 		Description string `json:"description"`
33: 		SiteCode    string `json:"site_code"`
34: 	}
35: 	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
36: 		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "invalid payload"})
37: 		return
38: 	}
39: 	id := uuid.NewString()
40: 	_, err := h.DB.Exec(`
41: 		INSERT INTO job_postings(id, code, title, description, site_code, created_at)
42: 		VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,now())
43: 	`, id, req.Code, req.Title, req.Description, req.SiteCode)
44: 	if err != nil {
45: 		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "job create failed", "detail": err.Error()})
46: 		return
47: 	}
48: 	c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, gin.H{"id": id})
49: }
50: 
51: func (h *HiringHandler) ListJobs(c *gin.Context) {
52: 	rows, err := h.DB.Query(`
53: 		SELECT id::text, code, title, description, COALESCE(site_code,''), created_at
54: 		FROM job_postings
55: 		ORDER BY created_at DESC
56: 		LIMIT 200
57: 	`)
58: 	if err != nil {
59: 		c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": "failed to load jobs"})
60: 		return
61: 	}
62: 	defer rows.Close()
63: 
64: 	out := []gin.H{}
65: 	for rows.Next() {
66: 		var id, code, title, desc, site string
67: 		var createdAt time.Time
68: 		if rows.Scan(&id, &code, &title, &desc, &site, &createdAt) == nil {
69: 			out = append(out, gin.H{"id": id, "code": code, "title": title, "description": desc, "site_code": site, "created_at": createdAt})
70: 		}
71: 	}
72: 	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"jobs": out})
73: }
74: 
75: func (h *HiringHandler) ListApplications(c *gin.Context) {
76: 	rows, err := h.DB.Query(`
77: 		SELECT a.id::text, a.job_id::text, a.stage_code, a.source_type, a.created_at,
78: 		       c.id::text, c.full_name, COALESCE(c.email,''), COALESCE(c.phone,''),
79: 		       COALESCE(dh.risk_score,0), COALESCE(dh.triggers,'')
80: 		FROM applications a
81: 		JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id
82: 		LEFT JOIN candidate_dedupe_hits dh ON dh.candidate_id=c.id
83: 		ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
84: 		LIMIT 300
85: 	`)
86: 	if err != nil {
87: 		c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": "failed to load applications"})
88: 		return
89: 	}
90: 	defer rows.Close()
91: 
92: 	out := []gin.H{}
93: 	for rows.Next() {
94: 		var appID, jobID, stage, source, candidateID, fullName, email, phone, triggers string
95: 		var createdAt time.Time
96: 		var risk int
97: 		if rows.Scan(&appID, &jobID, &stage, &source, &createdAt, &candidateID, &fullName, &email, &phone, &risk, &triggers) == nil {
98: 			out = append(out, gin.H{
99: 				"application_id": appID,
100: 				"job_id":         jobID,
101: 				"stage_code":     stage,
102: 				"source_type":    source,
103: 				"created_at":     createdAt,
104: 				"candidate": gin.H{
105: 					"id":        candidateID,
106: 					"full_name": fullName,
107: 					"email":     email,
108: 					"phone":     phone,
109: 				},
110: 				"risk_score": risk,
111: 				"triggers":   strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(triggers), ","),
112: 			})
113: 		}
114: 	}
115: 	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"applications": out})
116: }
117: 
118: func (h *HiringHandler) ListPipelineTemplates(c *gin.Context) {
119: 	rows, err := h.DB.Query(`
120: 		SELECT id::text, code, name, min_stages, max_stages, active, created_at
121: 		FROM pipeline_templates
122: 		ORDER BY created_at DESC
123: 		LIMIT 100
124: 	`)
125: 	if err != nil {
126: 		c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": "failed to load pipeline templates"})
127: 		return
128: 	}

21: func ComputeConfirmationStatus(reserved, confirmed int) (string, int, error) {
22: 	if reserved < 0 || confirmed < 0 || confirmed > reserved {
23: 		return "", 0, errors.New("confirmed quantity out of range")
24: 	}
25: 	if confirmed == reserved {
26: 		return "CONFIRMED", 0, nil
27: 	}
28: 	return "PARTIAL_CONFIRMED", reserved - confirmed, nil
29: }

31: func (s *InventoryService) DeterministicAllocate(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, siteCode, sku string, qty int) (inventory.AllocationResult, error) {
32: 	rows, err := tx.QueryContext(ctx, `
33: 		SELECT wp.warehouse_code
34: 		FROM warehouse_priorities wp
35: 		WHERE wp.site_code=$1
36: 		ORDER BY wp.priority_rank ASC
37: 	`, siteCode)
38: 	if err != nil {
39: 		return inventory.AllocationResult{}, err
40: 	}
41: 	priorityWarehouses := []string{}
42: 	for rows.Next() {
43: 		var wh string
44: 		if rows.Scan(&wh) == nil {
45: 			priorityWarehouses = append(priorityWarehouses, wh)
46: 		}
47: 	}
48: 	rows.Close()
49: 
50: 	for _, wh := range priorityWarehouses {
51: 		var id string
52: 		var onHand, reserved int
53: 		err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `
54: 			SELECT id::text, on_hand, reserved
55: 			FROM inventory_balances
56: 			WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2
57: 			ORDER BY sub_warehouse_code
58: 			LIMIT 1
59: 			FOR UPDATE
60: 		`, wh, sku).Scan(&id, &onHand, &reserved)
61: 		if err != nil {
62: 			continue
63: 		}
64: 		if onHand-reserved >= qty {
65: 			_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE inventory_balances SET reserved=reserved+$2, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid`, id, qty)
66: 			if err != nil {
67: 				return inventory.AllocationResult{}, err
68: 			}
69: 			return inventory.AllocationResult{WarehouseCode: wh, AllocatedQty: qty, Deterministic: true}, nil
70: 		}
71: 	}
72: 
73: 	return inventory.AllocationResult{}, errors.New("insufficient stock in prioritized warehouses")
74: }
75: 
76: func (s *InventoryService) CreateLedger(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, movementType, sku, wh, reason string, qty int, userID string) error {
77: 	if reason == "" {
78: 		return errors.New("reason code required")
79: 	}
80: 	_, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
81: 		INSERT INTO inventory_ledger(id, movement_type, sku, quantity, warehouse_code, reason_code, created_by)
82: 		VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::uuid)
83: 	`, uuid.NewString(), movementType, sku, qty, wh, reason, userID)
84: 	return err
85: }

87: func (s *InventoryService) MoveStock(ctx context.Context, movementType, sku, fromWH, toWH, reason string, qty int, userID string) error {
88: 	if qty <= 0 {
89: 		return errors.New("quantity must be positive")
90: 	}
91: 	tx, err := s.DB.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
92: 	if err != nil {
93: 		return err
94: 	}
95: 	defer tx.Rollback()
96: 
97: 	if movementType == "INBOUND" {
98: 		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
99: 			UPDATE inventory_balances SET on_hand=on_hand+$3, updated_at=now()
100: 			WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2
101: 		`, toWH, sku, qty)
102: 		if err != nil {
103: 			return err
104: 		}
105: 		if err := s.CreateLedger(ctx, tx, movementType, sku, toWH, reason, qty, userID); err != nil {
106: 			return err
107: 		}
108: 		return tx.Commit()
109: 	}
110: 
111: 	if movementType == "OUTBOUND" {
112: 		var onHand, reserved int
113: 		err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT on_hand, reserved FROM inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2 FOR UPDATE`, fromWH, sku).Scan(&onHand, &reserved)
114: 		if err != nil {
115: 			return err
116: 		}
117: 		if onHand-reserved < qty {
118: 			return errors.New("insufficient available stock")
119: 		}
120: 		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE inventory_balances SET on_hand=on_hand-$3, updated_at=now() WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2`, fromWH, sku, qty)
121: 		if err != nil {
122: 			return err
123: 		}
124: 		if err := s.CreateLedger(ctx, tx, movementType, sku, fromWH, reason, -qty, userID); err != nil {
125: 			return err
126: 		}
127: 		return tx.Commit()
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if movementType == "TRANSFER" {
131: 		if fromWH == toWH {
132: 			return errors.New("from and to warehouse cannot be same")
133: 		}
134: 		var onHand, reserved int
135: 		err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT on_hand, reserved FROM inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2 FOR UPDATE`, fromWH, sku).Scan(&onHand, &reserved)
136: 		if err != nil {
137: 			return err
138: 		}
139: 		if onHand-reserved < qty {
140: 			return errors.New("insufficient available stock")
141: 		}
142: 		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE inventory_balances SET on_hand=on_hand-$3, updated_at=now() WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2`, fromWH, sku, qty); err != nil {
143: 			return err
144: 		}
145: 		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE inventory_balances SET on_hand=on_hand+$3, updated_at=now() WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2`, toWH, sku, qty); err != nil {
146: 			return err
147: 		}
148: 		if err := s.CreateLedger(ctx, tx, "TRANSFER_OUT", sku, fromWH, reason, -qty, userID); err != nil {
149: 			return err
150: 		}
151: 		if err := s.CreateLedger(ctx, tx, "TRANSFER_IN", sku, toWH, reason, qty, userID); err != nil {
152: 			return err
153: 		}
154: 		return tx.Commit()
155: 	}
156: 
157: 	return fmt.Errorf("unsupported movement type %s", movementType)

300: 	err := h.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT on_hand FROM inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_code=$1 AND sku=$2`, req.WarehouseCode, req.SKU).Scan(&expected)

21: func NewComplianceService(db *sql.DB) *ComplianceService {
22: 	return &ComplianceService{DB: db}
23: }
24: 
25: func (s *ComplianceService) RunCrawler() (int, int, error) {
26: 	rows, err := s.DB.Query(`
27: 		SELECT id::text, folder_path, min_interval_minutes, COALESCE(last_run_at, 'epoch'::timestamptz), nightly_cap, opt_out_marker
28: 		FROM crawler_sources
29: 		WHERE approved=true
30: 		ORDER BY last_run_at NULLS FIRST
31: 	`)
32: 	if err != nil {
33: 		return 0, 0, err
34: 	}
35: 	defer rows.Close()
36: 
37: 	indexed := 0
38: 	queued := 0
39: 	globalCap := 5000
40: 
41: 	for rows.Next() && indexed < globalCap {
42: 		var sourceID, folder string
43: 		var minInterval int
44: 		var lastRun time.Time
45: 		var capPerSource int
46: 		var marker string
47: 		if err := rows.Scan(&sourceID, &folder, &minInterval, &lastRun, &capPerSource, &marker); err != nil {
48: 			continue
49: 		}
50: 
51: 		if time.Since(lastRun) < time.Duration(minInterval)*time.Minute {
52: 			continue
53: 		}
54: 
55: 		files := []string{}
56: 		_ = filepath.WalkDir(folder, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
57: 			if err != nil {
58: 				return nil
59: 			}
60: 			if d.IsDir() {
61: 				if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err == nil {
62: 					return filepath.SkipDir
63: 				}
64: 				return nil
65: 			}
66: 			files = append(files, path)
67: 			return nil
68: 		})
69: 
70: 		sort.Strings(files)
71: 		sourceProcessed := 0
72: 		for _, f := range files {
73: 			if indexed >= globalCap || sourceProcessed >= capPerSource {
74: 				_, _ = s.DB.Exec(`INSERT INTO crawler_queue(source_id, file_path, status) VALUES ($1::uuid,$2,'PENDING') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, sourceID, f)
75: 				queued++
76: 				continue
77: 			}
78: 			content, err := os.ReadFile(f)
79: 			if err != nil {
80: 				continue
81: 			}
82: 			h := sha256.Sum256(content)
83: 			excerpt := string(content)
84: 			if len(excerpt) > 500 {
85: 				excerpt = excerpt[:500]
86: 			}
87: 			excerpt = masking.MaskSSN(excerpt)
88: 			_, _ = s.DB.Exec(`
89: 				INSERT INTO searchable_index_entries(id, source_id, file_path, checksum, masked_excerpt)
90: 				VALUES ($1,$2::uuid,$3,$4,$5)
91: 				ON CONFLICT (file_path) DO UPDATE SET checksum=excluded.checksum, masked_excerpt=excluded.masked_excerpt, indexed_at=now()
92: 			`, uuid.NewString(), sourceID, f, hex.EncodeToString(h[:]), sanitizeText(excerpt))
93: 			indexed++
94: 			sourceProcessed++
95: 		}
96: 
97: 		_, _ = s.DB.Exec(`UPDATE crawler_sources SET last_run_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid`, sourceID)
98: 	}
99: 
100: 	return indexed, queued, nil
101: }
102: 
103: func sanitizeText(s string) string {
104: 	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "\x00", "")
105: 	return s
106: }

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"meridian/backend/internal/bootstrap"
	"meridian/backend/internal/config"
	"meridian/backend/internal/http/handlers"
	"meridian/backend/internal/http/middleware"
	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/db"
	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/security"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.Load()

	database, err := db.Open(cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("db open failed: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	migrationDir := filepath.Join(".", "migrations")
	if _, err := os.Stat(migrationDir); err != nil {
		migrationDir = filepath.Join("/app", "migrations")
	}
	if err := db.Migrate(context.Background(), database, migrationDir); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("migration failed: %v", err)
	}

	if err := bootstrap.SeedAdminAndKeys(database, cfg.DefaultAdminUser, cfg.DefaultAdminPass, cfg.BootstrapClientKey, cfg.BootstrapClientSec, cfg.PIIKeyName, cfg.PIIKeyValue); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("bootstrap failed: %v", err)
	}

	tokens := security.NewTokenManager(cfg.JWTSecret)
	pii := security.NewPIIProtector(database, cfg.PIIKeyName, cfg.PIIKeyValue)
	if err := pii.EnsureBootstrapKey(); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("pii key bootstrap failed: %v", err)
	}
	authHandler := handlers.NewAuthHandler(database, tokens, cfg.AccessTTL, cfg.RefreshTTL, cfg.StepUpTTL)
	hiringHandler := handlers.NewHiringHandler(database, cfg.EnableFuzzyDedup, pii)
	supportHandler := handlers.NewSupportHandler(database)
	inventoryHandler := handlers.NewInventoryHandler(database)
	adminHandler := handlers.NewAdminHandler(database)
	complianceHandler := handlers.NewComplianceHandler(database)

	r := gin.Default()
	r.GET("/healthz", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"ok": true})
	})

	r.POST("/auth/login", authHandler.Login)
	r.POST("/auth/refresh", authHandler.Refresh)

	api := r.Group("/api")
	api.Use(middleware.RequireSignedRequests(database))
	api.Use(middleware.RequireAccessToken(tokens))
	api.Use(middleware.AuditWrites(database))
	api.POST("/auth/step-up", authHandler.StepUp)
	api.GET("/auth/me", authHandler.Me)
	api.Use(middleware.RequireIdempotency(database, cfg.IdempotencyTTL))

	hiring := api.Group("/hiring")
	hiring.GET("/jobs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.ListJobs)
	hiring.GET("/applications", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.ListApplications)
	hiring.GET("/pipelines/templates", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.ListPipelineTemplates)
	hiring.GET("/pipelines/templates/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetPipelineTemplate)
	hiring.POST("/jobs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.CreateJob)
	hiring.POST("/applications/manual", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.CreateManualApplication)
	hiring.POST("/applications/kiosk", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site"), hiringHandler.CreateKioskApplication)
	hiring.POST("/applications/import-csv", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), hiringHandler.ImportCSV)
	hiring.POST("/pipelines/templates", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.CreatePipelineTemplate)
	hiring.PUT("/pipelines/templates/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.UpdatePipelineTemplate)
	hiring.POST("/pipelines/validate", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.ValidatePipeline)
	hiring.POST("/applications/:id/transition", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.TransitionApplication)
	hiring.GET("/applications/:id/allowed-transitions", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetAllowedTransitions)
	hiring.GET("/applications/:id/events", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetPipelineEvents)
	hiring.GET("/candidates/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetCandidate)
	hiring.POST("/blocklist/rules", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.CreateBlocklistRule)

	support := api.Group("/support")
	support.GET("/tickets", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "view"), supportHandler.ListTickets)
	support.POST("/tickets", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "create"), supportHandler.CreateTicket)
	support.GET("/tickets/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "view"), supportHandler.GetTicket)
	support.PUT("/tickets/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "update"), supportHandler.UpdateTicket)
	support.POST("/tickets/:id/attachments", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "update"), supportHandler.AddAttachment)
	support.POST("/tickets/:id/conflict-resolve", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "update"), supportHandler.ResolveConflict)
	support.POST("/tickets/refund-approve",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "approve"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "refund_approval"),
		supportHandler.ApproveRefund,
	)

	inventory := api.Group("/inventory")
	inventory.GET("/balances", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "view"), inventoryHandler.GetBalances)
	inventory.GET("/reservations", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "view"), inventoryHandler.ListReservations)
	inventory.POST("/inbound", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.MoveInbound)
	inventory.POST("/outbound", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.MoveOutbound)
	inventory.POST("/transfers", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.MoveTransfer)
	inventory.POST("/cycle-counts", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.CycleCount)
	inventory.POST("/reservations/order-create", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.CreateReservation)
	inventory.POST("/reservations/:id/confirm", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "update"), inventoryHandler.ConfirmReservation)
	inventory.POST("/reservations/:id/release", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "update"), inventoryHandler.ReleaseReservation)
	inventory.POST("/ledger/:id/reverse",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "approve"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "delete_or_reversal"),
		inventoryHandler.ReverseLedger,
	)

	admin := api.Group("/admin")
	admin.GET("/roles", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "view"), adminHandler.ListRoles)
	admin.PUT("/roles/:id/permissions",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "update"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "role_permission_change"),
		adminHandler.UpdateRolePermissions,
	)
	admin.PUT("/roles/:id/scopes",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "update"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "role_permission_change"),
		adminHandler.UpdateRoleScopes,
	)
	admin.POST("/client-keys/rotate",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "update"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "role_permission_change"),
		adminHandler.RotateClientKey,
	)
	admin.POST("/client-keys/:id/revoke",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "delete"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "delete_or_reversal"),
		adminHandler.RevokeClientKey,
	)

	compliance := api.Group("/compliance")
	compliance.POST("/crawler/run", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "create"), complianceHandler.RunCrawler)
	compliance.GET("/crawler/status", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.CrawlerStatus)
	compliance.POST("/deletion-requests", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "create"), complianceHandler.CreateDeletionRequest)
	compliance.GET("/deletion-requests", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.ListDeletionRequests)
	compliance.POST("/deletion-requests/:id/process", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "approve"), complianceHandler.ProcessDeletionRequest)
	compliance.GET("/retention/jobs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.RetentionStatus)
	compliance.GET("/audit-logs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.AuditLogs)
	compliance.GET("/audit-logs/export",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "export"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "export"),
		complianceHandler.ExportAuditLogs,
	)

	log.Printf("backend-api listening on :%s", cfg.Port)
	if err := r.Run(":" + cfg.Port); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("server failed: %v", err)

package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"meridian/backend/internal/bootstrap"
	"meridian/backend/internal/config"
	"meridian/backend/internal/http/handlers"
	"meridian/backend/internal/http/middleware"
	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/db"
	"meridian/backend/internal/platform/security"
)

func main() {
	cfg := config.Load()

	database, err := db.Open(cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("db open failed: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	migrationDir := filepath.Join(".", "migrations")
	if _, err := os.Stat(migrationDir); err != nil {
		migrationDir = filepath.Join("/app", "migrations")
	}
	if err := db.Migrate(context.Background(), database, migrationDir); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("migration failed: %v", err)
	}

	if err := bootstrap.SeedAdminAndKeys(database, cfg.DefaultAdminUser, cfg.DefaultAdminPass, cfg.BootstrapClientKey, cfg.BootstrapClientSec, cfg.PIIKeyName, cfg.PIIKeyValue); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("bootstrap failed: %v", err)
	}

	tokens := security.NewTokenManager(cfg.JWTSecret)
	pii := security.NewPIIProtector(database, cfg.PIIKeyName, cfg.PIIKeyValue)
	if err := pii.EnsureBootstrapKey(); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("pii key bootstrap failed: %v", err)
	}
	authHandler := handlers.NewAuthHandler(database, tokens, cfg.AccessTTL, cfg.RefreshTTL, cfg.StepUpTTL)
	hiringHandler := handlers.NewHiringHandler(database, cfg.EnableFuzzyDedup, pii)
	supportHandler := handlers.NewSupportHandler(database)
	inventoryHandler := handlers.NewInventoryHandler(database)
	adminHandler := handlers.NewAdminHandler(database)
	complianceHandler := handlers.NewComplianceHandler(database)

	r := gin.Default()
	r.GET("/healthz", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"ok": true})
	})

	r.POST("/auth/login", authHandler.Login)
	r.POST("/auth/refresh", authHandler.Refresh)

	api := r.Group("/api")
	api.Use(middleware.RequireSignedRequests(database))
	api.Use(middleware.RequireAccessToken(tokens))
	api.Use(middleware.AuditWrites(database))
	api.POST("/auth/step-up", authHandler.StepUp)
	api.GET("/auth/me", authHandler.Me)
	api.Use(middleware.RequireIdempotency(database, cfg.IdempotencyTTL))

	hiring := api.Group("/hiring")
	hiring.GET("/jobs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.ListJobs)
	hiring.GET("/applications", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.ListApplications)
	hiring.GET("/pipelines/templates", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.ListPipelineTemplates)
	hiring.GET("/pipelines/templates/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetPipelineTemplate)
	hiring.POST("/jobs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.CreateJob)
	hiring.POST("/applications/manual", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site", "assigned"), hiringHandler.CreateManualApplication)
	hiring.POST("/applications/kiosk", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), middleware.RequireScope(database, "hiring", "global", "site"), hiringHandler.CreateKioskApplication)
	hiring.POST("/applications/import-csv", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "create"), hiringHandler.ImportCSV)
	hiring.POST("/pipelines/templates", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.CreatePipelineTemplate)
	hiring.PUT("/pipelines/templates/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.UpdatePipelineTemplate)
	hiring.POST("/pipelines/validate", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.ValidatePipeline)
	hiring.POST("/applications/:id/transition", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.TransitionApplication)
	hiring.GET("/applications/:id/allowed-transitions", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetAllowedTransitions)
	hiring.GET("/applications/:id/events", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetPipelineEvents)
	hiring.GET("/candidates/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "view"), hiringHandler.GetCandidate)
	hiring.POST("/blocklist/rules", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "hiring", "update"), hiringHandler.CreateBlocklistRule)

	support := api.Group("/support")
	support.GET("/tickets", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "view"), supportHandler.ListTickets)
	support.POST("/tickets", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "create"), supportHandler.CreateTicket)
	support.GET("/tickets/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "view"), supportHandler.GetTicket)
	support.PUT("/tickets/:id", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "update"), supportHandler.UpdateTicket)
	support.POST("/tickets/:id/attachments", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "update"), supportHandler.AddAttachment)
	support.POST("/tickets/:id/conflict-resolve", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "update"), supportHandler.ResolveConflict)
	support.POST("/tickets/refund-approve",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "support", "approve"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "refund_approval"),
		supportHandler.ApproveRefund,
	)

	inventory := api.Group("/inventory")
	inventory.GET("/balances", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "view"), inventoryHandler.GetBalances)
	inventory.GET("/reservations", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "view"), inventoryHandler.ListReservations)
	inventory.POST("/inbound", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.MoveInbound)
	inventory.POST("/outbound", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.MoveOutbound)
	inventory.POST("/transfers", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.MoveTransfer)
	inventory.POST("/cycle-counts", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.CycleCount)
	inventory.POST("/reservations/order-create", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "create"), inventoryHandler.CreateReservation)
	inventory.POST("/reservations/order-cancel", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "update"), inventoryHandler.CancelOrderReservations)
	inventory.POST("/reservations/:id/confirm", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "update"), inventoryHandler.ConfirmReservation)
	inventory.POST("/reservations/:id/release", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "update"), inventoryHandler.ReleaseReservation)
	inventory.POST("/ledger/:id/reverse",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "inventory", "approve"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "delete_or_reversal"),
		inventoryHandler.ReverseLedger,
	)

	admin := api.Group("/admin")
	admin.GET("/roles", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "view"), adminHandler.ListRoles)
	admin.PUT("/roles/:id/permissions",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "update"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "role_permission_change"),
		adminHandler.UpdateRolePermissions,
	)
	admin.PUT("/roles/:id/scopes",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "update"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "role_permission_change"),
		adminHandler.UpdateRoleScopes,
	)
	admin.POST("/client-keys/rotate",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "update"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "role_permission_change"),
		adminHandler.RotateClientKey,
	)
	admin.POST("/client-keys/:id/revoke",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "admin", "delete"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "delete_or_reversal"),
		adminHandler.RevokeClientKey,
	)

	compliance := api.Group("/compliance")
	compliance.POST("/crawler/run", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "create"), complianceHandler.RunCrawler)
	compliance.GET("/crawler/status", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.CrawlerStatus)
	compliance.POST("/deletion-requests", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "create"), complianceHandler.CreateDeletionRequest)
	compliance.GET("/deletion-requests", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.ListDeletionRequests)
	compliance.POST("/deletion-requests/:id/process",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "approve"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "delete_or_reversal"),
		complianceHandler.ProcessDeletionRequest,
	)
	compliance.GET("/retention/jobs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.RetentionStatus)
	compliance.GET("/audit-logs", middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "view"), complianceHandler.AuditLogs)
	compliance.GET("/audit-logs/export",
		middleware.RequirePermission(database, "compliance", "export"),
		middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "export"),
		complianceHandler.ExportAuditLogs,
	)

	log.Printf("backend-api listening on :%s", cfg.Port)
	if err := r.Run(":" + cfg.Port); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("server failed: %v", err)
	}
}

package handlers

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

)

func TestExportAuditLogs_MasksSensitivePatterns(t *testing.T) {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	db, mock, _ := sqlmock.New()
	defer db.Close()

	h := NewComplianceHandler(db)

	rows := sqlmock.NewRows([]string{"actor_id", "action_class", "entity_type", "entity_id", "event_data", "created_at"}).
		AddRow("u1", "EXPORT", "candidate", "c1", `{"ssn":"123-45-6789"}`, time.Now())
	mock.ExpectQuery("SELECT actor_id, action_class, entity_type, entity_id, event_data::text, created_at").
		WithArgs(500).
		WillReturnRows(rows)

	r := gin.New()
	r.GET("/x", h.ExportAuditLogs)

	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/x?format=csv", nil)
	r.ServeHTTP(w, req)

	if w.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 got %d", w.Code)
	}
	body := w.Body.String()
	if !strings.Contains(body, "***-**-6789") {
		t.Fatalf("expected masked ssn in export, got %s", body)
	}
}

func TestProcessDeletionRequest_RequiresStepUpToken(t *testing.T) {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	db, mock, _ := sqlmock.New()
	defer db.Close()

	h := NewComplianceHandler(db)
	tokens := security.NewTokenManager("test-secret")

	r := gin.New()
	r.Use(func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.Set(middleware.CtxUserID, "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111")
		c.Next()
	})
	r.POST("/deletion/:id/process", middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "delete_or_reversal"), h.ProcessDeletionRequest)

	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/deletion/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/process", nil)
	r.ServeHTTP(w, req)
	if w.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("expected 403 without step-up token, got %d", w.Code)
	}

	stepUp, err := tokens.CreateStepUpToken("11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111", "delete_or_reversal", time.Minute)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	mock.ExpectQuery("SELECT COALESCE\(policy_result,'"+""+"'\) FROM deletion_requests").WithArgs("11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111").WillReturnRows(
		sqlmock.NewRows([]string{"policy"}).AddRow("anonymize"),
	)
	mock.ExpectExec("UPDATE candidates SET full_name='ANONYMIZED'").WithArgs("11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111").WillReturnResult(sqlmock.NewResult(1, 1))
	mock.ExpectExec("UPDATE deletion_requests SET status='COMPLETED'").WithArgs("11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111").WillReturnResult(sqlmock.NewResult(1, 1))

	w2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	req2 := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/deletion/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/process", nil)
	req2.Header.Set("X-Step-Up-Token", stepUp)
	r.ServeHTTP(w2, req2)
	if w2.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 with valid step-up token, got %d", w2.Code)
	}

	if err := mock.ExpectationsWereMet(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

+		}
+	}

import json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method,path,payload=None,token=None,step=None):
    data=None
    if payload is not None:
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request(BASE+path,data=data,method=method)

Implemented ΓÇö I closed all 5 requested gaps and verified behavior with tests + runtime smoke checks.

- Reservation cancellation flow is now explicit and auditable:
  - Added `POST /api/inventory/reservations/order-cancel` in `backend/cmd/api/main.go`.
  - Implemented order-level cancellation release logic in `backend/internal/service/inventory_service.go` (`ReleaseReservationsForOrderCancellation`), releasing only unreleased/unconfirmed hold qty.
  - Added reusable release logic with event persistence and reason codes (`ReleaseReservationByID`), used by manual release, cancellation, and worker expiry paths.
  - Added/standardized reason-coded reservation events in `backend/internal/http/handlers/inventory.go` (`ORDER_HOLD_CREATED`, `PARTIAL_UNCONFIRMED_RELEASE`, `ORDER_CANCELED`, etc.).

- Nightly crawler execution is now in worker runtime:
  - Added `NightlyCrawlerScheduler` and nightly trigger path in `backend/cmd/worker/jobs.go`.
  - Wired nightly execution in worker loop in `backend/cmd/worker/main.go`.
  - Manual crawler endpoint behavior remains unchanged (`/api/compliance/crawler/run` still calls same crawler service).
  - Nightly run still uses existing `ComplianceService.RunCrawler()` constraints (approved sources, opt-out marker, min interval, cap/queue rollover) in `backend/internal/service/compliance_service.go`.

- Step-up is enforced for deletion processing:
  - Added `middleware.RequireStepUp(tokens, "delete_or_reversal")` to deletion processing route in `backend/cmd/api/main.go`.
  - Requests without `X-Step-Up-Token` are now rejected before handler execution.

- Retention now covers financial records in addition to support records:
  - Extended worker retention job in `backend/cmd/worker/jobs.go` to anonymize old `orders.customer_ref` (financial record handling) using deterministic age anchor (`created_at <= now() - interval '7 years'`).
  - Kept immutability-safe behavior (anonymization rather than destructive delete where inappropriate).
  - Exposed due-count in compliance status response via `financial_records_due` in `backend/internal/http/handlers/compliance.go`.

- Low-stock thresholds are now role-aware with fallback:
  - Added role/site/sku-aware threshold resolution in `backend/internal/service/inventory_service.go` (`ResolveSafetyStockThreshold`), with fallback to `20`.
  - Updated balances API to use resolved threshold per user+sku and compute low-stock on **available** stock (`on_hand - reserved`) in `backend/internal/http/handlers/inventory.go`.

**Tests added/updated**
- `backend/internal/service/inventory_service_test.go`
  - cancellation-triggered release behavior (partial confirmation releases only unconfirmed qty)
  - role-aware threshold + fallback resolution
- `backend/cmd/worker/jobs_test.go`
  - reservation auto-release path with event/balance updates
  - nightly crawler execution path (once per night)
  - retention includes financial anonymization
- `backend/internal/http/handlers/compliance_test.go`
  - deletion processing blocked without step-up, succeeds with valid step-up
- `backend/internal/http/handlers/inventory_test.go`
  - balances response uses role-aware threshold and low-stock computed from available qty

**Validation performed**
- Backend tests: `go test ./...` (containerized) Γ£à
- Frontend tests: `go test ./...` (containerized) Γ£à
- Rebuilt stack: `docker compose up --build -d` Γ£à
- Smoke-verified:
  - order cancellation immediately releases reservations with audit reason Γ£à
  - deletion processing returns `403` without step-up and `200` with valid step-up Γ£à

If you want, I can now do a quick README/API route update for the new `order-cancel` endpoint and retention/status additions.

## Required Work Plan (execute in order)
### Phase 1: Exhaustive Assessment (inside fullstack only)
Audit all major surfaces:
1. Runnability + docs
- startup/build/test instructions
- local non-Docker verification clarity
- mismatch between docs and actual code
2. Frontend security + behavior
- token storage/transport/session lifecycle
- route/page protection before render
- role/module/action gating correctness
- user-switch leakage (cache/local state)
- offline drafts/retry/conflict logic integrity
- sensitive data exposure in UI/logs/client storage
3. Backend security + authorization
- authentication correctness
- permission middleware consistency
- object-level authorization
- tenant/site/assignment isolation
- scope enforcement consistency across all handlers
- sensitive endpoints requiring step-up
- signature/nonce/idempotency correctness
4. Data/compliance controls
- PII encryption/masking paths
- retention/deletion behavior correctness
- immutable/auditable ledger guarantees
- crawler guardrails (caps, allowlists, opt-out behavior)
5. Engineering quality
- coupling/hotspots
- oversized files with mixed responsibilities
- unsafe defaults and config hygiene
- error handling consistency
6. Testing sufficiency
- unit, integration/API, and end-to-end style coverage
- happy path, failure path, authz boundary, and race/retry edge cases
Stop only when findings are clearly saturated (not after only top few).
---
### Phase 2: Implement Fixes
Apply a comprehensive but disciplined remediation, including:
A) Frontend
- Replace insecure token persistence patterns (avoid long-lived sensitive tokens in localStorage).
- Harden protected-route behavior (deny/redirect before protected page use).
- Ensure logout/session invalidation is complete.
- Preserve offline/retry/conflict UX without weakening security.
- Avoid exposing secrets or sensitive user data in browser-side logs/storage.
B) Backend
- Enforce object-level and tenant/site isolation in all relevant read/write endpoints.
- Ensure scope checks are not optional or inconsistently applied.
- Tighten sensitive action controls (step-up, permission gates, actor checks).
- Keep request signing + nonce replay + idempotency robust and consistent.
C) Config + docs
- Remove or harden insecure secret defaults.
- Introduce secure-fail behavior for missing required secrets in non-dev usage.
- Update `README.md` with:
  - secure configuration setup,
  - local non-Docker verification steps (if feasible),
  - test commands and expected outcomes.
D) Maintainability
- Refactor only where necessary to reduce security-critical complexity.
- Keep architecture coherent and avoid broad unnecessary rewrites.
---
### Phase 3: Testing
Add and/or update tests with emphasis on:
1. Frontend tests
- session/token lifecycle behavior
- protected route behavior
- permission-based visibility/interaction integrity
- critical retry/conflict flows
2. Backend tests
- object-level authorization denials
- cross-user/site isolation
- scope enforcement by endpoint
- step-up-protected action behavior
- signing/nonce/idempotency regression cases
3. Integration-style checks
- at least one meaningful business flow per major module:
  - hiring
  - support
  - inventory
  - compliance
If any test cannot be added due to architecture limits, implement the nearest feasible automated safety net and explain.
---
### Phase 4: Verification (No Docker)
Run non-Docker checks available within `fullstack`, such as:
- language-native tests,
- static checks/lint where configured,
- targeted smoke checks that do not require containers.
If some verification is blocked, explicitly state:
- what was attempted,
- why blocked,
- exact command a maintainer can run later.
---
## Quality Bar
- No placeholder fixes.
- No silent security trade-offs.
- No TODO-only remediation for critical items.
- Preserve existing business requirements unless they conflict with security/correctness.
- Ensure all changed logic has tests where practical.
---
## Final Output Format (mandatory)
Provide a final report with these sections:
1. `Remediation Summary`
- concise overview of what was fixed
2. `Findings Addressed (Exhaustive)`
For each finding:
- severity
- problem
- root cause
- file(s) changed
- fix implemented
- residual risk (if any)
3. `Files Changed`
- grouped by frontend/backend/docs/config/tests
4. `Verification Performed`
- commands run
- pass/fail outcomes
- blockers
5. `Test Coverage Delta`
- what new tests were added
- what scenarios are now covered
- what remains uncovered
6. `Breaking Changes`
- list any API/behavior changes and migration notes
7. `Remaining Risks / Follow-ups`
- short, prioritized list with rationale
---

100:     const refresh = localStorage.getItem("refresh_token");
101:     if (!refresh) return false;
102:     const res = await fetch("/rpc/refresh", {
103:       method: "POST",
104:       headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
105:       body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refresh }),
106:     });
107:     if (!res.ok) return false;
108:     const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));

114:   async function apiFetch(url, opts) {
115:     const options = opts || {};
116:     const method = options.method || "GET";
117:     const headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
118:     if (options.auth !== false && localStorage.getItem("access_token")) {
119:       headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("access_token")}`;
120:     }
121:     if (options.idempotency) headers["Idempotency-Key"] = crypto.randomUUID();
122:     if (options.stepUp && localStorage.getItem("step_up_token")) {
123:       headers["X-Step-Up-Token"] = localStorage.getItem("step_up_token");
124:     }
125: 
126:     const req = {
127:       method,
128:       headers,
129:       body: method === "GET" ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.body || {}),
130:     };
131: 
132:     let res = await fetch(url, req);
133:     if (res.status === 401 && options.auth !== false) {
134:       if (await refreshAccessToken()) {
135:         req.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem("access_token")}`;
136:         res = await fetch(url, req);
137:       }
138:     }
139: 
140:     const contentType = res.headers.get("Content-Type") || "";
141:     const body = contentType.includes("application/json")
142:       ? await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
143:       : await res.text().catch(() => "");
144: 
145:     if (!res.ok) throw { status: res.status, ...(typeof body === "object" ? body : { error: body }) };
146:     return body;
147:   }

151:   const apiPut = (url, body) => apiFetch(url, { method: "PUT", body, auth: true });
